model: One board; 48 channels; six spatial ports; body actions 0,1,3; one fixed sign triple; Rule3 only; all components prepared at time zero.

status_meanings.proven: Mathematical statement within its explicit preparation/environment domain

status_meanings.not_demonstrated: No accepted implementation of the stated capability

Finite OR/NO route competition under the registered phase, lengths and boundaries. Not highest-complexity preference or internal approval.
